lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰਿ ਦਯਾਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੑਾਯਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਵਸਿ ਪੰਚ ਕਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: satagur dayaal har naam driRhaayaa tis prasaad vas pa(n)ch kare ||
lines.translation: The Merciful True Guru has implanted the Lord's Name within me, and by His Grace, I have overpowered the five thieves.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਵਿ ਕਲੵ ਠਕੁਰ ਹਰਦਾਸ ਤਨੇ ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਸਰ ਅਭਰ ਭਰੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: kav kaly thakur haradaas tane gur raamadaas sar abhar bhare ||3||
lines.translation: So speaks KALL the poet: Guru Raam Daas, the son of Har Daas, fills the empty pools to overflowing. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਭਉ ਉਨਮਾਨਿ ਅਕਲ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਸਹਜ ਘਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: anabhau unamaan akal liv laagee paaras bhetiaa sahaj ghare ||
lines.translation: With intuitive detachment, He is lovingly attuned to the Fearless, Unmanifest Lord; He met with Guru Amar Daas, the Philosopher's Stone, within his own home.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਯਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਇ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਭਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: satagur parasaad param pad paayaa bhagat bhaai bha(n)daar bhare ||
lines.translation: By the Grace of the True Guru, He attained the supreme status; He is overflowing with the treasures of loving devotion.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਟਿਆ ਜਨਮਾਂਤੁ ਮਰਣ ਭਉ ਭਾਗਾ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਸੰਤੋਖ ਸਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: metiaa janamaa(n)t maran bhau bhaagaa chit laagaa sa(n)tokh sare ||
lines.translation: He was released from reincarnation, and the fear of death was taken away. His consciousness is attached to the Lord, the Ocean of contentment.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਵਿ ਕਲੵ ਠਕੁਰ ਹਰਦਾਸ ਤਨੇ ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਸਰ ਅਭਰ ਭਰੇ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: kav kaly thakur haradaas tane gur raamadaas sar abhar bhare ||4||
lines.translation: So speaks KALL the poet: Guru Raam Daas, the son of Har Daas, fills the empty pools to overflowing. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਭਰ ਭਰੇ ਪਾਯਉ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਧਾਰਿਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: abhar bhare paayau apaar rid a(n)tar dhaario ||
lines.translation: He fills the empty to overflowing; He has enshrined the Infinite within His heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਆਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਬੋਧੁ ਮਨਿ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: dukh bha(n)jan aatam prabodh man tat beechaario ||
lines.translation: Within His mind, He contemplates the essence of reality, the Destroyer of pain, the Enlightener of the soul.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਚਾਇ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਇ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸੁ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa chaai har bhaai prem ras aape jaanai ||
lines.translation: He yearns for the Lord's Love forever; He Himself knows the sublime essence of this Love.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਸਹਜ ਸੇਤੀ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: satagur kai parasaad sahaj setee ra(n)g maanai ||
lines.translation: By the Grace of the True Guru, He intuitively enjoys this Love.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਅੰਗਦ ਸੁਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਅਮਰਿ ਅਮਰੁ ਵਰਤਾਇਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak prasaad a(n)gad sumat gur amar amar varataaio ||
lines.translation: By the Grace of Guru Nanak, and the sublime teachings of Guru Angad, Guru Amar Daas broadcast the Lord's Command.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਕਲੵੁਚਰੈ ਤੈਂ ਅਟਲ ਅਮਰ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਓ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: gur raamadaas kalyucharai tai(n) atal amar pad paaio ||5||
lines.translation: So speaks KALL: O Guru Raam Daas, You have attained the status of eternal and imperishable dignity. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤੋਖ ਸਰੋਵਰਿ ਬਸੈ ਅਮਿਅ ਰਸੁ ਰਸਨ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)tokh sarovar basai ami ras rasan prakaasai ||
lines.translation: You abide in the pool of contentment; Your tongue reveals the Ambrosial Essence.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਤ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਦੁਰਤੁ ਦੂਰੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਸੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: milat saa(n)t upajai durat doora(n)tar naasai ||
lines.translation: Meeting with You, a tranquil peace wells up, and sins run far away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਪਾਇਅਉ ਦਿੰਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਗਿ ਨ ਹੁਟੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sukh saagar paaiau di(n)t har mag na hutai ||
lines.translation: You have attained the Ocean of peace, and You never grow tired on the Lord's path.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਜਮੁ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਸੀਲ ਸੰਨਾਹੁ ਮਫੁਟੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)jam sat sa(n)tokh seel sa(n)naahu maphutai ||
lines.translation: The armor of self-restraint, truth, contentment and humility can never be pierced.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਣੁ ਬਿਧ ਨੈ ਸਿਰਿਉ ਜਗਿ ਜਸ ਤੂਰੁ ਬਜਾਇਅਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur pramaan bidh nai siriu jag jas toor bajaaiau ||
lines.translation: The Creator Lord certified the True Guru, and now the world blows the trumpet of His Praises.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਕਲੵੁਚਰੈ ਤੈ ਅਭੈ ਅਮਰ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਅਉ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: gur raamadaas kalyucharai tai abhai amar pad paaiau ||6||
lines.translation: So speaks KALL: O Guru Raam Daas, You have attained the state of fearless immortality. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਗੁ ਜਿਤਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਣਿ ਮਨਿ ਏਕੁ ਧਿਆਯਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jag jitau satigur pramaan man ek dhiaayau ||
lines.translation: O certified True Guru, You have conquered the world; You meditate single-mindedly on the One Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨਿ ਧਨਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਮਰਦਾਸੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਯਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhan dhan satigur amaradaas jin naam driRaayau ||
lines.translation: Blessed, blessed is Guru Amar Daas, the True Guru, who implanted the Naam, the Name of the Lord, deep within.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਦਾਸੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: nav nidh naam nidhaan ridh sidh taa kee daasee ||
lines.translation: The Naam is the wealth of the nine treasures; prosperity and supernatural spiritual powers are His slaves.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਸਰੋਵਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: sahaj sarovar milio purakh bhetio abinaasee ||
lines.translation: He is blessed with the ocean of intuitive wisdom; He has met with the Imperishable Lord God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਲੇ ਭਗਤ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਗਿ ਤਰੇ ਸੋ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਅਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: aad le bhagat jit lag tare so gur naam driRaaiau ||
lines.translation: The Guru has implanted the Naam deep within; attached to the Naam, the devotees have been carried across since ancient times.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਕਲੵੁਚਰੈ ਤੈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਇਅਉ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: gur raamadaas kalyucharai tai har prem padaarath paaiau ||7||
lines.translation: So speaks KALL: O Guru Raam Daas, You have obtained the wealth of the Lord's Love. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਪਰਵਾਹ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪੁਬਲੀ ਨ ਹੁਟਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: prem bhagat paravaah preet pubalee na hutai ||
lines.translation: The flow of loving devotion and primal love does not stop.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਥਾਹੁ ਅਮਿਅ ਧਾਰਾ ਰਸੁ ਗੁਟਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur sabad athaahu ami dhaaraa ras gutai ||
lines.translation: The True Guru drinks in the stream of nectar, the sublime essence of the Shabad, the Infinite Word of God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਤਿ ਮਾਤਾ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਪਿਤਾ ਸਰਿ ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਯਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: mat maataa sa(n)tokh pitaa sar sahaj samaayau ||
lines.translation: Wisdom is His mother, and contentment is His father; He is absorbed in the ocean of intuitive peace and poise.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਜੋਨੀ ਸੰਭਵਿਅਉ ਜਗਤੁ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨਿ ਤਰਾਯਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: aajonee sa(n)bhaviau jagat gur bachan taraayau ||
lines.translation: The Guru is the Embodiment of the Unborn, Self-illumined Lord; by the Word of His Teachings, the Guru carries the world across.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਬਿਗਤ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਅਪਰਪਰੁ ਮਨਿ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਵਸਾਇਅਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: abigat agochar aparapar man gurasabad vasaaiau ||
lines.translation: Within His mind, the Guru has enshrined the Shabad, the Word of the Unseen, Unfathomable, Infinite Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਕਲੵੁਚਰੈ ਤੈ ਜਗਤ ਉਧਾਰਣੁ ਪਾਇਅਉ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: gur raamadaas kalyucharai tai jagat udhaaran paaiau ||8||
lines.translation: So speaks KALL: O Guru Raam Daas, You have attained the Lord, the Saving Grace of the world. ||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਗਤ ਉਧਾਰਣੁ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਭਗਤਹ ਭਵ ਤਾਰਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jagat udhaaran nav nidhaan bhagatah bhav taaran ||
lines.translation: The Saving Grace of the world, the nine treasures, carries the devotees across the world-ocean.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬੂੰਦ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਿਸੁ ਕੀ ਬਿਖੈ ਨਿਵਾਰਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit boo(n)d har naam bis kee bikhai nivaaran ||
lines.translation: The Drop of Ambrosial Nectar, the Lord's Name, is the antidote to the poison of sin.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਤਰੋਵਰ ਫਲਿਓ ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਫਲ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sahaj tarovar phalio giaan a(n)mrit phal laage ||
lines.translation: The tree of intuitive peace and poise blossoms and bears the ambrosial fruit of spiritual wisdom.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਪਾਈਅਹਿ ਧੰਨਿ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਬਡਭਾਗੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur prasaad paaeeahi dha(n)n te jan badabhaage ||
lines.translation: Blessed are those fortunate people who receive it, by Guru's Grace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇ ਮੁਕਤੇ ਭਏ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਚਾ ਪਾਇਅਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: te mukate bhae satigur sabad man gur parachaa paaiau ||
lines.translation: They are liberated through the Shabad, the Word of the True Guru; their minds are filled with the Guru's Wisdom.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਕਲੵੁਚਰੈ ਤੈ ਸਬਦ ਨੀਸਾਨੁ ਬਜਾਇਅਉ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: gur raamadaas kalyucharai tai sabad neesaan bajaaiau ||9||
lines.translation: So speaks KALL: O Guru Raam Daas, You beat the drum of the Shabad. ||9||
